## Teaching interests

I am interested in teaching courses related to wireless communications, communication networks, signal processing, optimization, machine learning for communications, probability, and algorithms.

Potential course areas include:

- Wireless communications
- Communication networks
- 5G/6G mobile networks
- Integrated sensing and communication
- Optimization for communication systems
- Machine learning for wireless networks
- Probability and stochastic processes
- Data structures and algorithms
